title: Permit to Dig / Excavation Permit
name: Permit to Dig / Excavation Permit
description: Permit for breaking ground, excavation and trenching, covering service location, safe digging, excavation stability and reinstatement.

sections.title: PLANNING AND SERVICE INFORMATION
items: Current utility / service information has been obtained and reviewed before work starts
The work area and excavation limits have been physically identified
Known underground electrical, gas, water, drainage, telecoms and other services have been considered
Overhead services and plant access hazards have been considered
Service owners have been contacted where required and any restrictions understood
The excavation method and sequence are suitable for the known ground and service conditions

fields.label: Utility / Service Drawing References and Dates

sections.title: LOCATING AND MARKING UNDERGROUND SERVICES
items: A suitable locating device has been used by a competent person before excavation
The locator has been function checked and is suitable for the services being sought
The full proposed excavation area has been scanned, including parallel and crossing services
Detected services have been clearly marked on the ground and the marks will be maintained
Trial holes / hand digging will be used to positively identify service position and depth where necessary
Absence of a locator signal has not been treated as proof that no service exists

fields.label: Scan Results / Service Positions and Depths

sections.title: SAFE EXCAVATION CONTROLS
items: Mechanical excavation limits and hand-dig requirements have been defined from the risk assessment and service information
Safe digging tools and techniques will be used near suspected or confirmed services
Exposed services will be supported and protected from damage
Spoil, materials and plant will be kept far enough from excavation edges to avoid surcharge and collapse
Suitable barriers / edge protection and warning signs are in place
Safe access and egress are provided
Vehicle and plant movements are segregated or controlled by a banksman where necessary
Water ingress, contaminated ground and hazardous atmospheres have been considered
Emergency arrangements for service strikes, collapse, flooding or other foreseeable events have been briefed

sections.title: EXCAVATION STABILITY AND INSPECTION
items: Ground conditions and risk of collapse have been assessed by a competent person
Battering, benching, shoring, trench box or other support is provided where required
Adjacent structures, roads, foundations and temporary works have been considered
Excavation support has been installed in accordance with its design / manufacturer instructions
A competent person will inspect the excavation before work starts and after events likely to affect stability
Inspection findings and defects will be recorded and unsafe excavations taken out of use

sections.title: REINSTATEMENT AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Services have been inspected and protected before backfilling
Backfill and compaction method will not damage services
Required marker tape, tiles, ducts or protection have been reinstated
Surface finish has been restored or temporary protection clearly identified
Service drawings / as-built information will be updated where required
The work area is safe for normal access and the permit can be closed
